This '''Ukian worker''' lived on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a friend of [[Tonzet]] and helped him. He met [[Sanya]] when she and [[Tyzen Xebec]] went to [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] to inspect the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]].
